conviction.explanation: Current-session English batch refresh. Fundamentals and analyst sentiment favor the bull case, but the technical sell signal is strong enough to keep the overall research view neutral.

executive_summary: Meta has a 30.1% net margin, $46.1B free cash flow, debt-to-equity of about 0.39, and a 17.2x forward P/E below its 22.6x trailing P/E. Price is below the 20- and 200-day averages but slightly above the 50-day average; RSI is 40.8 and the MACD histogram is negative.
bull_case: Strong profitability, cash generation, low leverage, and highly positive analyst recommendations support a longer-term recovery case.
bear_case: Weak medium-term price structure and negative MACD could signal that the apparently attractive forward valuation reflects lower earnings expectations.
key_uncertainties: Whether forward earnings growth is sustainable
Whether price can recover the 200-day average
The absence of current news headlines in the local snapshot
